description: This file defines an interface for rendering form-related widgets and fields within the OFBiz framework. It includes method signatures for rendering various input types, form structures, headers, and other UI components used in form rendering.

classes.name: FormStringRenderer
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for rendering various form fields, headers, and structural components in a web UI within the OFBiz framework. It abstracts the rendering logic for different form inputs and layouts.
